name: WF02 — Storyboard-First Planning
description: V6 storyboard-first planning: research -> semantic director -> deterministic media/diagram feasibility -> final narration. No mandatory multimodal visual reviewer.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  i.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  j.id AS job_id,
  j.topic,
  j.language_code,
  j.target_duration_seconds,
  j.status,
  j.current_stage,
  j.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  (j.status='created' AND j.current_stage='intake') AS eligible
FROM (SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id) i
LEFT JOIN public.jobs j ON j.id=i.job_id;

parameters.jsCode: const j=$('Prepare Semantic Intent').first().json;const r=$input.first().json;let t=String(r.text??'').trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'').trim();let o;try{o=JSON.parse(t)}catch{throw new Error('semantic candidate model returned invalid JSON')};const clean=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();const raw=Array.isArray(o.candidates)?o.candidates:[];if(raw.length<1||raw.length>5)throw new Error(`semantic candidate count ${raw.length} is outside 1-5`);const ids=new Set();const candidates=raw.map((x,i)=>{const candidate_id=clean(x.candidate_id),canonical_name=clean(x.canonical_name??x.candidate_name),subject_type=clean(x.subject_type),context=clean(x.context),interpretation=clean(x.interpretation),discovery_query=clean(x.discovery_query);if(candidate_id!==`C${i+1}`||ids.has(candidate_id)||!canonical_name||!subject_type||!interpretation||!discovery_query)throw new Error(`semantic candidate ${i+1} is invalid`);ids.add(candidate_id);return {candidate_id,canonical_name,subject_type,context,interpretation,discovery_query};});const common={...j,topic_language:clean(o.topic_language)||'unknown',topic_kind:clean(o.topic_kind)||'other',semantic_candidates:candidates,candidate_model:String(r.model??'')};return candidates.map(c=>({json:{...common,candidate_id:c.candidate_id,discovery_query:c.discovery_query}}));

const j=$('Build Evidence Comparison').first().json;const r=$input.first().json;let t=String(r.text??'').trim().replace(/^\`\`\`(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*\`\`\`$/,'').trim();let o;try{o=JSON.parse(t)}catch{throw new Error('evidence-grounded topic resolver returned invalid JSON')};const clean=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim();const rawForms=forms(j.raw_topic);const exact=[];for(const c of j.semantic_candidates){const values=[c.canonical_name,...fold(c.canonical_name).split(' '),c.context];const candidateForms=new Set(values.flatMap(v=>[...forms(v)]));if([...rawForms].some(x=>candidateForms.has(x)))exact.push(c);}const ids=new Set(j.semantic_candidates.map(x=>x.candidate_id));const evidenceIds=new Set(j.discovery_evidence.map(x=>x.evidence_id));let selected=clean(o.selected_candidate_id);if(!ids.has(selected))throw new Error('resolver selected unknown candidate '+selected);let policy='evidence_comparison';if(exact.length===1&&j.discovery_evidence.some(e=>e.candidate_id===exact[0].candidate_id)&&selected!==exact[0].candidate_id){selected=exact[0].candidate_id;policy='unique_exact_surface_form_over_longer_lookalike';}const chosen=j.semantic_candidates.find(x=>x.candidate_id===selected);let reasoning=[...new Set((Array.isArray(o.reasoning_evidence_ids)?o.reasoning_evidence_ids:[]).map(clean))].filter(x=>evidenceIds.has(x)&&j.discovery_evidence.find(e=>e.evidence_id===x)?.candidate_id===selected);if(!reasoning.length)reasoning=j.discovery_evidence.filter(e=>e.candidate_id===selected).slice(0,2).map(e=>e.evidence_id);if(!reasoning.length){reasoning=j.discovery_evidence.slice(0,2).map(e=>e.evidence_id);policy='resolver_global_evidence_fallback';}if(!reasoning.length)throw new Error('topic discovery returned no usable evidence');let confidence=Number(o.confidence),margin=Number(o.score_margin);if(!Number.isFinite(confidence)||confidence<0||confidence>1||!Number.isFinite(margin)||margin<0||margin>1)throw new Error('resolver confidence or score margin is invalid');if(policy!=='evidence_comparison'){confidence=Math.max(0.8,confidence);margin=Math.max(0.25,margin);}const canonical=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.canonical_name)||chosen.canonical_name):chosen.canonical_name,resolved=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.resolved_subject)||canonical):chosen.canonical_name,subjectType=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.subject_type)||chosen.subject_type):chosen.subject_type,context=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.context)||chosen.context):chosen.context,intent=policy==='evidence_comparison'?(clean(o.user_intent)||chosen.interpretation):chosen.interpretation,query=policy==='evidence_comparison'?clean(o.research_query_en):chosen.discovery_query;if(!canonical||!resolved||!subjectType||!intent||!query)throw new Error('resolved topic contract is incomplete');const reason=policy==='evidence_comparison'?clean(o.resolution_reason):'A unique exact surface-form match outranks a longer lexical lookalike unless independent evidence establishes an alias relationship.';const topic_resolution={version:'evidence-grounded-topic-resolution-v1',raw_topic:j.raw_topic,topic_language:j.topic_language,topic_kind:j.topic_kind,resolved_subject:resolved,canonical_name:canonical,subject_type:subjectType,context,selected_candidate_id:selected,runner_up_candidate_id:clean(o.runner_up_candidate_id)==='null'?null:(clean(o.runner_up_candidate_id)||null),confidence,score_margin:margin,decision_policy:policy,reasoning_evidence_ids:reasoning,resolution_reason:reason,candidates:j.semantic_candidates,discovery_evidence:j.discovery_evidence};return [{json:{...j,canonical_subject:canonical,resolved_subject:resolved,subject_type:subjectType,subject_context:context,user_intent:intent,search_query_en:query,topic_resolution,resolution_model:String(r.model??'')}}];

parameters.query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE public.jobs SET status='failed',current_stage='script',last_error=$2::text,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status<>'failed' RETURNING id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error) SELECT * FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT id AS job_id,status,current_stage,last_error FROM public.jobs WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='failed';

parameters.jsCode: const base=$('Prepare Final Story Request').first().json,r=$input.first().json,clean=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').replace(/\s+/gu,' ').trim(),speech=v=>clean(v).replace(/\s+\/\s+/gu,' ').replace(/\s+\|\s+/gu,' ').replace(/\s+(?:→|->)\s+/gu,' ').trim();if(r.provider_exhausted===true)throw new Error('free-only final story provider exhausted');let text=clean(r.text).replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/u,''),o;try{o=JSON.parse(text)}catch{throw new Error('final storyboard narration returned invalid JSON')}const raw=Array.isArray(o.units)?o.units:[];if(raw.length!==base.feasible_storyboard.length)throw new Error(`final narration unit count ${raw.length}/${base.feasible_storyboard.length}`);const units=[],bundles=[],evidenceIds=new Set(),scriptSupport=[];for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++){const scene=base.feasible_storyboard[i],scene_id=clean(raw[i]?.scene_id),narration=speech(raw[i]?.narration);if(scene_id!==scene.scene_id||!narration)throw new Error(`final narration unit ${i+1} changed storyboard identity`);scene.grounded_fact_ids.forEach(id=>evidenceIds.add(id));const shotAssets=scene.shots.map(sh=>sh.asset),shotPlan=scene.shots.map(sh=>({asset_id:sh.asset.asset_id,shot_id:sh.shot_id,shot_intent:sh.communication_goal,representation:sh.representation,crop_policy:sh.crop_policy})),assetIds=shotAssets.map(a=>a.asset_id);units.push({unit_id:`U${i+1}`,scene_id,claim_id:scene_id,grounded_claim:scene.narration_intent,narration,evidence_ids:[...scene.grounded_fact_ids],editorial_role:scene.purpose,communication_goal:scene.narration_intent,asset_id:assetIds[0],asset_ids:assetIds,shot_plan:shotPlan});bundles.push({asset_id:assetIds[0],shot_assets:shotAssets});scriptSupport.push({segment_number:i+1,unit_id:`U${i+1}`,evidence_ids:[...scene.grounded_fact_ids],source_ids:[...scene.grounded_fact_ids],text:narration,transform:'storyboard_first_grounded_paraphrase'});}const script=units.map(u=>u.narration).join(' '),wc=script.match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]+(?:[’'\-][\p{L}\p{N}]+)*/gu)?.length??0;if(wc<Math.max(18,Number(base.target_word_min)-12)||wc>Number(base.target_word_max)+16)throw new Error(`final storyboard word count ${wc} outside broad duration bounds`);if(evidenceIds.size<2)throw new Error('final storyboard does not retain at least two research evidence rows');const rowMap=new Map(base.research_rows.map(x=>[x.id,x])),selected_evidence=[...evidenceIds].map((id,index)=>{const x=rowMap.get(id);if(!x)throw new Error(`final storyboard cites unknown evidence ${id}`);return {evidence_id:id,source_id:id,source_language:'en',source_title:x.title,source_url:x.url,passage_id:'searx-snippet',section:null,evidence_text:x.snippet,selection_score:100-index,selection_rank:index+1}});const wps={en:2.55,pl:2.25,ru:2.45,uk:2.35}[base.language_code]??2.4,predicted=wc/wps,story_package={version:'storyboard-first-v1',editorial_contract_version:'storyboard-v1',visual_binding_mode:'representation-first-v1',units,assets:bundles,feasibility_version:base.feasibility_version};return parameters.query: WITH input AS (SELECT $1::uuid job_id,$2::text script_text,$3::jsonb script_support,$4::jsonb duration_preflight,$5::text narration_engine,$6::text narration_model,$7::text narration_prompt_version,$8::smallint script_fit_passes,$9::jsonb evidence_json,$10::text fact_source_language,$11::text fact_primary_title,$12::jsonb topic_resolution,$13::jsonb story_package), locked AS (SELECT j.id FROM public.jobs j,input i WHERE j.id=i.job_id AND j.status='created' AND j.current_stage='intake' AND j.story_package IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=j.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.job_evidence e WHERE e.job_id=j.id) FOR UPDATE), parsed AS (SELECT x.* FROM input i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(i.evidence_json) AS x(evidence_id text,source_id text,source_language text,source_title text,source_url text,passage_id text,section text,evidence_text text,selection_score numeric,selection_rank integer)), valid AS (SELECT p.* FROM parsed p WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(p.evidence_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.source_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND p.source_language IN('en','pl','ru','uk') AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.source_title),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(p.evidence_text),'') IS NOT NULL AND p.selection_rank>0), ok AS (SELECT l.id FROM locked l,input i WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(i.script_text),'') IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(i.script_support)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(i.script_support)=jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units') AND jsonb_typeof(i.topic_resolution)='object' AND i.topic_resolution->>'version'='evidence-grounded-topic-resolution-v1' AND jsonb_typeof(i.story_package)='object' AND i.story_package->>'version'='storyboard-first-v1' AND jsonb_typeof(i.story_package->'units')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units') BETWEEN 2 AND 12 AND jsonb_typeof(i.story_package->'assets')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'assets')=jsonb_array_length(i.story_package->'units') AND COALESCE((i.duration_preflight->>'exact_tts_required')::boolean,false)=true AND COALESCE((i.duration_preflight->>'prediction_is_advisory')::boolean,false)=true AND (SELECT count(*) FROM valid)=(SELECT jsonb_array_length(i.evidence_json))), ins AS (INSERT INTO public.job_evidence(job_id,evidence_id,source_id,source_language,source_title,source_url,passage_id,section,evidence_text,selection_score,selection_rank) SELECT o.id,v.evidence_id,v.source_id,v.source_language,v.source_title,NULLIF(v.source_url,''),v.passage_id,NULLIF(v.section,''),v.evidence_text,v.selection_score,v.selection_rank FROM ok o CROSS JOIN valid v ORDER BY v.selection_rank RETURNING job_id), upd AS (UPDATE public.jobs j SET content_model_version='staged_v1',topic_resolution=i.topic_resolution,story_package=i.story_package,visual_search_queries_en=NULL,script_text=i.script_text,script_support=i.script_support,duration_preflight=i.duration_preflight,narration_engine=i.narration_engine,narration_model=i.narration_model,narration_prompt_version=i.narration_prompt_version,script_fit_passes=i.script_fit_passes,fact_source_language=i.fact_source_language,fact_primary_title=i.fact_primary_title,status='processing',current_stage='script',last_error=NULL,updated_at=now() FROM input i,ok o WHERE j.id=o.id AND j.id=i.job_id RETURNING j.id,jsonb_array_length(j.story_package->'units')::int AS story_unit_count) SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ins) inserted_evidence_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) job_updated,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.scenes s WHERE s.job_id=$1::uuid) scene_count,(SELECT story_unit_count FROM upd) story_unit_count;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;if(r.job_updated!==true||Number(r.inserted_evidence_count)<2||Number(r.story_unit_count)<2)throw new Error(`Storyboard-first story persistence failed: updated=${r.job_updated}, evidence=${r.inserted_evidence_count}, units=${r.story_unit_count}`);return [{json:{job_id:r.job_id,story_unit_count:Number(r.story_unit_count)}}];
